persona.personal:
# What's important to me

- High: Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date.
- Normal: colleagues asking me for help on RRC or modem logs, code reviews asked of me.
- Low: celebrations, cafeteria and transport notices, town hall recaps, newsletters, vendor marketing. Don't bother me with these.
- I am not a people manager, so actions meant only for managers don't apply to me.
- Only notify me for things due today or by tomorrow morning.

answers.answer: I'm a senior engineer on the Modem Protocol team, LTE/NR RRC, in Bangalore. Right now I'm getting the RRC re-establishment fix into the November release and leading our 3GPP RAN2 contributions.
Meera Iyer is my manager. Karthik Nair leads PLM releases for our team. Wei Zhang is our counterpart in the Seoul HQ modem group. Rahul Sharma, Divya Menon and Sanjay Rao are on my team.
Anything from Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, and anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date.
Celebrations, cafeteria and transport notices, town hall recaps, newsletters and vendor marketing. I'm not a people manager, so manager-only actions don't apply to me.
Only notify me for things due today or by tomorrow morning. Everything else can wait for my Today page.
PLM builds, Swarm code reviews, 3GPP work, HR and IT.

onboarding.fallback: Meera Iyer is my manager. Release blockers, customer escalations and 3GPP deadlines are urgent for me. Celebrations, cafeteria notices and newsletters are noise.
